name: Crypto
desc: Generate random passwords and hash existing text

actions.name: hash-text
actions.description: Converts text to a hash value using various hashing algorithms

actions.name: hmac-signature
actions.description: Converts text to a HMAC signed hash value using various hashing algorithms

actions.name: rsa-signature
actions.description: Signs text with an RSA private key using SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 (RSA-SHA256 by default)

actions.name: generate-password
actions.description: Generates a random password with the specified length

actions.name: base64-decode
actions.description: Converts base64 text back to plain text.

actions.name: base64-encode
actions.description: Converts plain text into base64 format.

actions.name: openpgpEncrypt
actions.description: Encrypt a file using OpenPGP public key
